result.title: EmberBase 6.3: official snapshot retention reference
result.text:
# EmberBase 6.3 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 6.3, snapshot retention is 56 calendar days (retention_days=56).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

result.title: EmberBase 6.3: checkpoint and parallel import defaults
result.text:
# EmberBase 6.3 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of EmberBase release 6.3.
The default checkpoint interval is 18 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=18).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 10 (max_parallel_imports=10).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.

result.title: EmberBase: archived legacy defaults, NOT release 6.3
result.text:
# Archived EmberBase legacy profile

This archive does NOT describe EmberBase 6.3. It documents an obsolete pre-release profile only.
Historical snapshot retention: 7 days. Historical checkpoint interval: 60 minutes. Historical maximum parallel imports: 1.
Current defaults must be obtained from documents for the exact release.

result.title: EmberBase: storage and import terminology
result.text:
# EmberBase glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.
